correctness.rationale: The unordered first-i subset of a uniform permutation is independent of its relative ordering; conditioning on the ith upper record excludes the maximum from each earlier position. For j<i the maximum necessarily exceeds j, giving -j/[ni(i-1)]; for j=i the sole conditional failure is S_i={1,...,i}, yielding the diagonal 1/n-1/[i binom(n,i)]; for j>i the later value is independent of the prefix record event. Summation yields row and global covariances. Interior positivity uses i binom(n,i)>=n(n-1); global n>=5 positivity uses the explicit binomial-reciprocal upper bound; n=2,3,4 evaluated exactly. The verifier computes 500825 exact assertions, independently enumerating permutations through n=8 and checking closed formulas to n=1000. Finite checks are corroboration, not a proof beyond the stated subset argument.

value.rationale: Records and excedances are canonical but differently indexed statistics in uniform random permutations. The complete cross-covariance kernel identifies the exact negative lower-triangular and nonnegative diagonal structure, proves a sharp global covariance reversal at n=5 and a persistent nonzero covariance with vanishing correlation. This position-resolved dependence information is not supplied by the ordinary record/Eulerian marginals and is a coherent all-size structural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
